responsibility: Declares the pass-1 symbol-building interface responsible for creating module, import/export, enumeration, hidden-type, and procedure-heading entities during the first semantic parse. The API is stack-oriented because it is invoked directly from grammar actions, and it focuses on scope creation and symbol-table population rather than full type completion or code generation.
same_name_distinction: This is the declaration-side API for pass-1 symbol building, describing the stack-oriented routines the parser actions call; P1SymBuild.mod contains their concrete scope, import/export, enumeration, hidden-type, and procedure-building behavior.
